question: What was the name of the first dynasty that ruled over Magadh kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryank dynasty.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 
 
Haryank dynasty

 
 
 
The Haryanka dynasty was the third ruling dynasty of Magadha, an empire of ancient India.<
